descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you great with numbers? Do you enjoy analysing financial information and understanding how the numbers tell a story? Are you tech‑savvy and curious to learn how finance works in a global organisation? We’re looking for an intern to join our Finance team who will support day‑to‑day accounting and reporting activities and gain hands‑on experience in a corporate finance environment. In this role, you will:
• Support accounting and financial activities within the Finance function
• Prepare and deliver financial reports such as Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, close packs, and other management reports in an accurate and timely manner
• Analyse and investigate variances, ensuring required adjustments are accurately reflected in the general ledger
• Perform reconciliations and analyse financial data to support financial reporting and controls
• Collaborate with colleagues and contribute to improving the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of financial processes and internal controls
• Gain exposure to financial reporting processes in a global organization and develop practical finance and analytical skills
